messages.subject: Calderdale House — report on title (confidential & privileged)
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Frances,

Please find attached our report on title and searches. In summary the title is good and marketable (title absolute, GM428193) and you can safely proceed at the agreed price. Points to note: (1) the seller's Pennine Business Bank charge must be discharged on completion — we'll hold their undertaking; (2) the Northbank break option on 29 Sep 2025 is the main income risk; (3) the lift overhaul; (4) VAT/TOGC — you'll need to opt to tax and notify HMRC before completion, which we'll manage; (5) SDLT of £412,000 will be payable.

Subject to those, we recommend proceeding to exchange. Let us know you're happy and we'll finalise the contract.

Kind regards,
Elena

—
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
This email is confidential and may be legally privileged.
